entries.prompt: Use case: fantasy game HUD asset. Create one square, isolated transparent PNG event icon for an approaching monster horde. Show a tight cluster of exactly three distinct tiny forest enemies (a tusked boar, a golden beetle, and a small leafy creature) charging forward together, with clear readable faces and overlapping silhouettes that read as a group. Low-poly 3D toy forms with painterly storybook shading, warm amber key light from upper left and subtle cool teal fill from the right, rich forest-green, bark-brown, and warm gold accents. Match a polished hand-painted low-poly game icon, not photorealism. Fill about 82% of the square and keep the silhouette bold enough to read at 32 pixels. True transparent background with clean alpha; no panel, no border, no circle badge, no text, no numbers, no environment, no floor, no cast shadow outside the characters.
entries.processing: Copied generated RGBA unchanged; native alpha preserved.
